prompt: Who can help my local business in Scottsdale get mentioned in ChatGPT answers?
text:
If you want your Scottsdale business to show up in ChatGPT recommendations and answers, you should look for an agency or consultant specializing in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), also called Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

This is different from traditional SEO. The goal is to make your business more likely to be:

- Recommended when someone asks ChatGPT for the best local businesses in Scottsdale.
- Mentioned when people ask for services in your industry.
- Included in AI-generated comparisons and buying recommendations.
- Recognized as a credible local business through consistent online information, reviews, expert content, and authoritative mentions.

## Scottsdale agencies worth contacting

I found several local companies that specifically advertise AI search visibility, GEO, or AEO services.

1. DIAP Media

Strong GEO specialization

- Scottsdale-based.
- Explicitly offers GEO for ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI.
- Published AI SEO pricing starts at $800/month; dedicated GEO programs are listed at $3,000–$10,000+ monthly.
- Website: [GEO services and pricing](https://diapmedia.com/scottsdale-seo/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

  6815 E Camelback Rd, Scottsdale

2. Cited Co

AI visibility specialist

- Focuses specifically on AI visibility for service businesses.
- Tracks mentions across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity.
- Publishes a case study involving a Scottsdale interior design business.
- Pricing starts at $2,500/month plus $3,000 onboarding, with a 12-month term.
- Website: [Cited Co AI visibility](https://citedco.ai/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

  Scottsdale, AZ

3. Lifted Websites

- Traditional SEO, local SEO, web design and GEO.
- Good candidate if your website also needs improvement.
- Website: [Lifted Websites](https://liftedwebsites.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

  6815 E Camelback Rd, Scottsdale

4. SP Marketing Experts

- Offers SEO, AEO and GEO.
- Combines website development, local search, reputation and AI search optimization.
- Website: [SEO, AEO and GEO services](https://spmarketingexperts.com/sem-seo/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

  9903 E Bell Rd, Scottsdale

## What I would ask before hiring anyone

Don't just pay someone to write AI-generated blog posts. Ask them:

1. Can you show me which ChatGPT prompts currently mention my competitors but not my business?
2. Can you demonstrate actual ChatGPT citations or recommendations you've earned for clients?
3. Do you improve third-party authority, local business listings, reviews, structured data and website content?
4. Will you track how frequently my business is mentioned over time?
5. Can I see a before-and-after report?

One important distinction: nobody can guarantee that ChatGPT will recommend your business for every relevant question. The right agency should measure actual visibility rather than promise rankings.

## Let me narrow this down to the right provider

The best choice depends heavily on what your business does. A med spa, contractor, restaurant, real estate company and law firm need different strategies to get recommended by ChatGPT.

What type of business do you own in Scottsdale?

I can then narrow this to the three strongest candidates, compare their pricing and identify which one is most likely to help your business become a recommended answer when potential customers ask ChatGPT for local providers.
